name: alakazam741_v8
archetype: Alakazam 741 pressure core + Dudunsparce + bench protection/recovery
summary: v3 pressure core with active Phase/Tier priorities, lethal/deck safety gates, three Battle Cage, three Night Stretcher, route-aware recovery, Hyper Aroma set selection, and no Boss's Orders or Crushing Hammer.
notes: Boss's Orders remains at 0 and all gust-specific logic remains removed.
Crushing Hammer 2 -> 0; Battle Cage 2 -> 3 and Night Stretcher 2 -> 3 after matchup review.
Battle Cage is played only to replace an opposing Stadium or answer a detected bench-attack threat.
Night Stretcher is used only when it completes an evolution, backup, engine, or basic-Psychic-energy route; target selection uses the same route-aware scoring.
The first missing Abra-line backup may be established before a non-winning attack, while the lethal-preservation gate still protects exact KOs.
Run Away Draw hard invariant: the last Pokemon in play can never shuffle itself away; Active Dudunsparce only cycles to a ready benched Alakazam.
Low-deck ACTIVATE refusal and lethal-preservation run on the real score dispatch path.
Enhanced Hammer is limited to removing effect-prevention energy when the post-play Powerful Hand immediately KOs.
BasePolicy owns selection/fallback, energy discipline, board-wide effect protection, PrizeTracker, make_agent, and whole-set custom selection support.

Golden-state tests cover 60-card composition, safety gates, Phase/Tier ordering, Lillie ordering, Battle Cage timing, route-aware Night Stretcher use, global protection, and three-card Hyper Aroma selection.
